title: Simple maps
examples: Where is the playground on this map?
What does this little picture mean?
How do we know where the classroom is?

explain.say: Look at this picture. It shows a big area from above.
This way of looking down is called a bird's-eye view. It helps us see everything at once.
Next, we can make a map of our own classroom. It shows where things are inside.
Maps use little pictures called symbols. Symbols help us understand things quickly.
For example, a little drawing of a tree means there is a real tree there.
A common mistake is thinking a map is the real place itself. A map is just a drawing that shows where things are located. It is like a picture guide for a real journey.

draw.text: Map is a drawing, not the place.

faq.q: What is the difference between a map and a real place?
faq.a: A map is a drawing that shows a real place. It is a picture of the area.
asks: Is a map like a drawing?
Does a map show the real thing?

faq.q: What does a bird's-eye view mean?
faq.a: It means looking down at something from very high up, like from a bird.
asks: How does a bird see the ground?

faq.a: Symbols help us draw big places without making the map too messy. They save space.
asks: Why are there little pictures on the map?
What do the symbols stand for?

faq.q: Can we make a map of our school?
faq.a: Yes, we can draw a map of our school grounds. We can put in symbols for the playground.
asks: Can we map the whole school?
What if we map the school?

faq.q: How do I find something on a map?
faq.a: You look for the symbol that matches what you are trying to find. Then you follow the lines.
asks: How do I find the door on the map?

facts: A map is a drawing of an area.
A bird's-eye view looks down from above.
Symbols are small pictures that stand for things.
A classroom map shows where things are inside.

quiz.say: When you look at a map, what view are you using?
quiz.why: The question asks what view a map shows, and that view is looking down from above.

wrong.0: This is wrong because while it is on the ground, the specific term for looking down is bird's-eye view.
wrong.2: This is wrong because a side view shows things from the edge, not from above.
wrong.3: This is wrong because a close-up only shows one small part, not the whole area.

quiz.say: If a map has a symbol of a chair, what does it mean?

options.show: It means the chair is broken
options.say: It means the chair is broken

quiz.why: Symbols are used to show what the drawing represents, so a chair symbol means a real chair.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the picture stands for something real in the location.
wrong.1: This is wrong because the symbol itself only shows the object, not its condition.
wrong.3: This is wrong because symbols show what is real in the place, not just toys.

quiz.say: What is the main purpose of drawing a classroom map?

options.show: To show where things are inside
options.say: To show where things are inside

options.show: To tell us what to play with
options.say: To tell us what to play with

quiz.why: The purpose of a classroom map is to help everyone know the position of furniture and areas inside.

wrong.1: This is wrong because decoration is for looking at, not for showing location.
wrong.2: This is wrong because counting is a number skill, not the main goal of mapping.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the map shows where things are, not what activities to do.
